findings.title: No visible cancellation action during a managed customer-account card payment

evidence.description: Dojo monitor has an internal cancel callback
Footer Cancel is disabled while accountSaving
Modal dismissal disabled while saving or managedcardapproved
Checkout has a visible Cancel Terminal control

findings.impact: A user who needs to abort an account debt repayment while a terminal is waiting cannot use the same on-screen cancellation available in checkout.
findings.verificationNeeded: Start an account-payment sandbox timeout session and inspect all visible controls; cancel on device only after root verifies UI absence.

findings.title: Change Price pad lacks a delete-last-digit control
findings.impact: Correcting a mistyped price requires clearing and re-entering the full amount in this pad.
findings.verificationNeeded: Open Change Price, enter1234 and check whether hardware Backspace works and whether a visible delete control exists.

findings.title: Recent receipts stops at latest50 and does not expose receipt-line details

evidence.description: History copy explicitly says latest50; static receiptcards

findings.impact: Older delivery investigations require another database/reporting route; item-by-item receipt inspection is unavailable here.
findings.verificationNeeded: Confirm available history controls and decide whether an older-history/detail feature belongs on the product roadmap.

highRiskRootVerification: Dojo sandbox only for payment/cancellation; confirm Saved API key and ownership are suitable before provider action
Use isolated mock sale/customer/session for goods sales, account repayments, loyaltycorrections, stockreceipts, refunds and shift/Zclosures
Z report previewcancel must release all barriers without closing period
Receipt/CSV/export buttons need actual native file/printer feedback before pass
Attendance multi-mode cache intentionally disables clock writes; record liveerror separately from expected offline gating
No broad deletion or databasewipe solely to exercise audit controls
